items.en: I can work out what matters to me in life and go after these things.
items.zh_working: 我能弄清楚生活中对自己重要的是什么，并去追求它们。

items.en: I try to distract myself to block out difficult thoughts and feelings.
items.zh_working: 我会设法让自己分心，把困难的想法和感受挡在外面。

items.en: I rush through activities that are important to me, without really paying attention.
items.zh_working: 做对自己重要的事情时，我常常匆匆忙忙，没有真正留意。

items.en: I behave in ways that reflect what is important to me.
items.zh_working: 我的行为方式能反映出对我重要的东西。

items.en: I get so tangled up in my thoughts that I don't do the things that really matter to me.
items.zh_working: 我会被自己的想法缠住，以至于做不了真正重要的事。

items.en: I find it hard to focus on the thing that I'm doing.
items.zh_working: 我很难把注意力放在正在做的事情上。

items.en: I choose to do what's important to me, even if it brings up difficult emotions.
items.zh_working: 即使会带来难受的情绪，我也选择去做对自己重要的事。

items.en: I tell myself it's wrong to have certain thoughts.
items.zh_working: 我告诉自己，有某些念头是不对的。

items.en: Even when I'm doing things that are important to me, I find myself doing them without paying attention.
items.zh_working: 即使在做对自己重要的事情，我也会发现自己心不在焉。

items.en: I live my life in a way that matches what I care about.
items.zh_working: 我的生活方式和我在乎的东西是一致的。

items.en: I try to avoid situations that might bring up difficult thoughts or feelings.
items.zh_working: 如果可能带来难受的想法或感受，我会回避那些情境。

items.en: I do things without being aware of what I'm doing.
items.zh_working: 我做事时意识不到自己在做什么。

items.en: I do things that matter to me, even when it is difficult.
items.zh_working: 即使困难，我也做对自己重要的事。

items.en: I try hard to block the feelings I don't want.
items.zh_working: 我会努力把不想要的感受挡住。

items.en: I often seem to do things without much awareness of what I'm doing.
items.zh_working: 我好像经常在没什么觉察的情况下把事情做了。

items.en: I can stick with things that I care about, even when it's difficult.
items.zh_working: 即使困难，我也能坚持做自己在乎的事。

items.en: I avoid things that are important to me, if there is a risk that I will feel upset.
items.zh_working: 如果有可能难过，我会回避对自己重要的事。

items.en: My values are really reflected in my behaviour.
items.zh_working: 我的价值观确实体现在我的行为里。

items.en: I can keep going with something when it is important to me.
items.zh_working: 只要对我很重要，我就能把一件事坚持做下去。

scores.label: 心理灵活性总分（19题）
scores.description: 11 个负向键题（OE、BA 全部）按 6−原始分反向后与 8 个正向键题相加，范围 0–138。分数越高表示越多报告心理灵活性。

scores.label: 价值行动（VA，8题）
scores.description: 八个正向键题原始分求和，范围 0–48。分数越高表示越多报告：清楚什么重要，并按它行动。

scores.label: 对体验的开放（OE，6题反向后）
scores.description: 六个负向键题反向后求和，范围 0–36。分数越高表示越少报告分心、回避和压制感受。

scores.label: 对行为的觉察（BA，5题反向后）
scores.description: 五个负向键题反向后求和，范围 0–30。分数越高表示越多报告做事时留意当下。

missingPolicy: complete_required；任一题缺失则该分数不计算，不插补、不补0。
